mechanism: Senna-induced diarrhea may reduce isotretinoin absorption and enterohepatic circulation, potentially decreasing therapeutic efficacy; senna's GI effects may mask or complicate isotretinoin-related GI adverse effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if bowel management necessary, use non-stimulant laxatives (docusate, polyethylene glycol) and monitor isotretinoin levels and clinical response.
